description: This is a test class file for the Goteo project, specifically testing the database interaction and caching functionalities in the Goteo\Core\DB class using PHPUnit.

classes.name: DBTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing database connection, query execution, and caching behaviors in Goteo\Core\DB.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates a new DB instance and verifies it is an instance of Goteo\Core\DB and \PDO.

methods.name: testSimpleSelect
methods.description: Executes simple SELECT statements and asserts the correctness of results, depending on a valid DB instance.

methods.name: testNonCachedSelect
methods.description: Tests executing a SQL query without caching, verifying different results for subsequent executions.

methods.name: testStatement
methods.description: Verifies cache settings on prepared statements and their cache time manipulation.

methods.name: testCachedSelect
methods.description: Checks if cached queries return consistent results within the cache lifetime, and different results after expiry.

methods.name: testInvalidateCache
methods.description: Tests cache invalidation via cleanCache and confirms new query results differ after cache is cleared.
